name: Crunchbase
summary: Database of private companies and investors.

flows.title: Search for companies or people
steps: Open the Advanced Search dropdown in the top global navigation bar, then select the type of search you want to build.
Refine your search using the categorized Filters at the top of the page; your results update in real time.
Customize your columns to view the specific data you're looking for, by clicking either the 3-dot menu on the right or the arrow on an existing column's header.

flows.title: Save a search
steps: Create the search first; this flow starts from a search that is already built.
Click the blue Save Search icon in the upper right-hand corner.
In the modal that appears, add a name for the search, and change its privacy settings or its email alert types and frequency, then click Save when finished.
The saved search can later be found in My Dashboard.

flows.title: Create a list from a search
steps: Start by creating a search, then select the entries to add by checking their boxes on the left individually, or check the top box in the Name column to reveal a Select All Results button.
Click the blue Save To List button that appears.
Choose to add the results to an existing list, or select Create New List.
Selecting Create New List opens a pop-up, where you name the list, update its privacy settings and choose the type and frequency of its email alerts.
